subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A teacher observes that students in the same class vary in how quickly they grasp new content, some needing more repetition and time than others, even with the same instruction. This variation in the rate of learning is called an individual difference in:
explanation: Rate of learning is a key dimension of individual difference — some learners need more time and repetition to reach the same level of mastery as others, requiring differentiated pacing in instruction.
